title_en: Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted in accordance with the Constitution for the purpose of regulating the establishment and implementation of administrative license, protecting the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons and other organizations, maintaining public interest and social order, and ensuring and supervising the effective exercise of administrative management by administrative organs.

Article 2 For the purpose of this Law, administrative license means the act whereby an administrative organ, upon the application of a citizen, legal person or any other organization and after examination according to law, permits the applicant to engage in a specific activity.

Article 3 This Law shall apply to the establishment and implementation of administrative license.
The examination and approval by an administrative organ of matters such as human affairs, financial affairs and foreign affairs of other organs or of institutions directly under its administration shall not be governed by this Law.
Article 4 The establishment and implementation of administrative license shall be carried out in accordance with the statutory authority, scope, conditions and procedures.

Article 5 The establishment and implementation of administrative license shall follow the principles of openness, fairness, impartiality and non-discrimination.
The provisions concerning administrative license shall be published; those which are not published shall not be used as the basis for implementing administrative license. The implementation and results of administrative license shall be made public, except for those involving state secrets, trade secrets or individual privacy. Without the consent of the applicant, the administrative organ and its staff, as well as persons participating in expert review, shall not disclose any trade secret, undisclosed information or confidential business information submitted by the applicant, unless otherwise provided by law or involving national security or major social public interests; where the administrative organ discloses the aforesaid information of the applicant according to law, the applicant shall be allowed to raise an objection within a reasonable period.
Where the statutory conditions and standards are met, the applicant shall have the equal right to obtain the administrative license according to law, and the administrative organ shall not discriminate against any person.
Article 6 The implementation of administrative license shall follow the principle of convenience for the people, improve work efficiency and provide quality services.

Article 7 Citizens, legal persons or other organizations shall, with regard to the implementation of administrative license by administrative organs, have the right to make statements and arguments; they shall have the right to apply for administrative reconsideration or bring an administrative action according to law; and if their lawful rights and interests are damaged due to the illegal implementation of administrative license by administrative organs, they shall have the right to claim compensation according to law.

Article 8 The administrative license lawfully obtained by a citizen, legal person or any other organization shall be protected by law, and the administrative organ shall not alter an effective administrative license without authorization.
If the laws, regulations or rules based on which the administrative license is granted are amended or abolished, or if the objective circumstances based on which the administrative license is granted undergo major changes, the administrative organ may, for the need of public interest, alter or revoke the effective administrative license according to law. Where property losses are thus caused to citizens, legal persons or other organizations, the administrative organ shall grant compensation according to law.

Article 9 An administrative license lawfully obtained shall not be transferred, except those which may be transferred in accordance with the statutory conditions and procedures as provided by laws and regulations.

Article 10 People's governments at or above the county level shall establish and improve a supervision system for the implementation of administrative license by administrative organs, and strengthen supervision and inspection over the implementation of administrative license by administrative organs.
Administrative organs shall exercise effective supervision over the activities of citizens, legal persons or other organizations in engaging in matters subject to administrative license.

Article 11 The establishment of administrative license shall follow the laws of economic and social development, be conducive to giving play to the initiative and enthusiasm of citizens, legal persons or other organizations, maintain public interest and social order, and promote the coordinated development of the economy, society and the ecological environment.

Article 14 For the matters listed in Article 12 of this Law, a law may establish an administrative license. Where no law has been enacted, an administrative regulation may establish an administrative license.
When necessary, the State Council may establish an administrative license by way of issuing a decision. After implementation, except for temporary administrative license matters, the State Council shall promptly request the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee to enact a law, or formulate an administrative regulation on its own.

Article 15 For the matters listed in Article 12 of this Law, where no law or administrative regulation has been enacted, a local regulation may establish an administrative license; where no law, administrative regulation or local regulation has been enacted, and due to the need of administrative management, it is indeed necessary to implement an administrative license immediately, a rule of the people's government of a province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government may establish a temporary administrative license. If a temporary administrative license needs to continue after one year of implementation, the local people's government shall request the people's congress of the same level or its standing committee to formulate a local regulation.
Local regulations and rules of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall not establish administrative licenses concerning the qualifications or credentials of citizens, legal persons or other organizations that shall be uniformly determined by the state; nor shall they establish administrative licenses concerning the registration of establishment of enterprises or other organizations or their pre-establishment. The administrative licenses established by them shall not restrict individuals or enterprises from other regions from engaging in production, operation and service provision in the locality, nor restrict the entry of goods from other regions into the local market.

Article 16 Administrative regulations may, within the scope of the administrative license matters established by law, make specific provisions on the implementation of such administrative license.
Local regulations may, within the scope of the administrative license matters established by laws and administrative regulations, make specific provisions on the implementation of such administrative license.
Rules may, within the scope of the administrative license matters established by the superior law, make specific provisions on the implementation of such administrative license.
The specific provisions made by regulations and rules on the implementation of an administrative license established by the superior law shall not create additional administrative licenses; the specific provisions made on the conditions for an administrative license shall not create additional conditions that violate the superior law.
Article 17 Except as provided for in Articles 14 and 15 of this Law, no other regulatory documents may establish an administrative license.
Article 18 When establishing an administrative license, the implementing organ, conditions, procedures and time limits for the administrative license shall be prescribed.

Article 19 When drafting a draft law, draft regulation or draft rule of the people's government of a province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government, where an administrative license is to be established, the drafting unit shall solicit opinions by holding hearings, feasibility studies and other means, and shall explain to the enacting authority the necessity of establishing such administrative license, the possible impact on the economy and society, and the situation of soliciting and adopting opinions.

Article 20 The authority establishing an administrative license shall periodically evaluate the administrative license it has established; where it considers that an established administrative license can be resolved by the means listed in Article 13 of this Law, it shall promptly amend or abolish the provisions establishing such administrative license.
The authority implementing an administrative license may, in a timely manner, evaluate the implementation and necessity of the established administrative license, and report its opinions to the authority that established the administrative license.
Citizens, legal persons or other organizations may submit opinions and suggestions to the authority establishing or implementing an administrative license regarding the establishment and implementation of the administrative license.

Article 21 The people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may, with respect to an administrative license for economic affairs established by administrative regulations, if it deems that the matter can be resolved by the means listed in Article 13 of this Law in light of the economic and social development of its administrative region, upon approval by the State Council, suspend the implementation of such administrative license within its administrative region.
Article 22 An administrative license shall be implemented by an administrative organ with the power to grant administrative licenses within the scope of its statutory functions and powers.

Article 23 An organization authorized by a law or regulation to manage public affairs may, within the scope of statutory authorization, implement administrative licenses in its own name. The authorized organization shall be subject to the provisions of this Law concerning administrative organs.

Article 24 An administrative organ may, within the scope of its statutory functions and powers and in accordance with the provisions of laws, regulations, and rules, entrust another administrative organ with the implementation of administrative licenses. The entrusting organ shall make an announcement regarding the entrusted administrative organ and the content of the entrusted implementation of administrative licenses.
The entrusting administrative organ shall be responsible for supervising the actions of the entrusted administrative organ in implementing administrative licenses and shall bear legal liability for the consequences of such actions.
The entrusted administrative organ shall implement administrative licenses in the name of the entrusting administrative organ within the entrusted scope; it shall not further entrust any other organization or individual with the implementation of administrative licenses.

Article 25 Upon approval by the State Council, the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government may, based on the principles of simplification, uniformity, and efficiency, decide that one administrative organ shall exercise the administrative license powers of relevant administrative organs.

Article 26 Where an administrative license requires processing by several internal organs of an administrative organ, the administrative organ shall designate one organ to uniformly accept the application for the administrative license and uniformly deliver the decision on the administrative license.
Where an administrative license is implemented separately by two or more departments of a local people's government according to law, the people's government at the same level may designate one department to accept the application for the administrative license and, after notifying the relevant departments to separately present their opinions, handle it uniformly, or organize the relevant departments to handle it jointly or centrally.

Article 27 When implementing an administrative license, an administrative organ shall not make improper demands on the applicant, such as purchasing designated commodities or accepting paid services.
When handling an administrative license, staff members of an administrative organ shall not extort or accept property from the applicant, and shall not seek other benefits.

Article 28 For the inspection, testing, and quarantine of equipment, facilities, products, and articles that directly concern public safety, human health, and the safety of life and property, unless otherwise provided by laws or administrative regulations that they shall be implemented by administrative organs, they shall gradually be implemented by professional and technical organizations that meet the statutory conditions. The professional and technical organizations and their relevant personnel shall bear legal liability for the conclusions of the inspections, tests, and quarantines they conduct.

Article 29 Citizens, legal persons, or other organizations that need to obtain an administrative license according to law for engaging in specific activities shall submit an application to the administrative authority. If the application form needs to be in a standard format, the administrative authority shall provide the applicant with the standard application form for the administrative license. The standard application form shall not contain content that has no direct relation to the matter of the administrative license application.
The applicant may entrust an authorized agent to submit the application for an administrative license, except where, according to law, the applicant shall submit the application in person at the office of the administrative authority.
Applications for administrative licenses may be submitted by letter, telegram, telex, facsimile, electronic data interchange, or email.

Article 30 The administrative authority shall publish at its office the matters, bases, conditions, quotas, procedures, time limits, as well as the catalog of all materials to be submitted and the sample application forms relating to administrative licenses as provided by laws, regulations, and rules.
If an applicant requests the administrative authority to explain or interpret the published content, the administrative authority shall make explanations or interpretations and provide accurate and reliable information.

Article 31 When applying for an administrative license, the applicant shall truthfully submit relevant materials and reflect the true situation to the administrative authority, and shall be responsible for the authenticity of the substantive content of the application materials. The administrative authority shall not require the applicant to submit technical data or other materials irrelevant to the matter for which the administrative license is applied.
The administrative authority and its staff shall not make technology transfer a condition for obtaining an administrative license, nor shall they, directly or indirectly, require technology transfer in the process of implementing an administrative license.

Article 33 The administrative authority shall establish and improve relevant systems, promote e-government, and publish matters relating to administrative licenses on its website to facilitate applicants to submit applications for administrative licenses by means of electronic data messages, etc.; it shall share relevant information on administrative licenses with other administrative authorities to improve work efficiency.

Article 34 The administrative authority shall review the application materials submitted by the applicant.
If the application materials submitted by the applicant are complete and conform to the statutory form, and the administrative authority can make a decision on the spot, it shall make a written decision on the administrative license on the spot.
If it is necessary to verify the substantive content of the application materials in accordance with the statutory conditions and procedures, the administrative authority shall assign two or more staff members to conduct the verification.

Article 35 For an administrative license that, according to law, shall be reviewed first by the lower-level administrative authority and then submitted to the higher-level administrative authority for decision, the lower-level administrative authority shall, within the statutory time limit, directly submit the preliminary review opinions and all application materials to the higher-level administrative authority. The higher-level administrative authority shall not require the applicant to submit the application materials repeatedly.

Article 36 When reviewing an application for an administrative license, if the administrative authority finds that the administrative license matter directly involves the vital interests of another person, it shall inform that interested party. The applicant and the interested party have the right to present statements and arguments. The administrative authority shall hear the opinions of the applicant and the interested party.

Article 37 After reviewing the application for an administrative license, the administrative authority shall, except where it makes an immediate decision on the administrative license, make a decision on the administrative license within the statutory time limit in accordance with the prescribed procedures.

Article 38 If the applicant's application meets the statutory conditions and standards, the administrative authority shall, according to law, make a written decision to grant the administrative license.
If the administrative authority makes a written decision not to grant the administrative license according to law, it shall state the reasons and inform the applicant of the right to apply for administrative reconsideration or bring an administrative action according to law.
Article 40 The decision made by the administrative authority to grant an administrative license shall be made public, and the public has the right to access it.

Article 41 If there is no geographical restriction on the scope of application of an administrative license established by laws or administrative regulations, the administrative license obtained by the applicant shall be valid throughout the whole country.

Article 42 Except where a decision can be made immediately, the administrative authority shall make a decision on the administrative license within twenty days from the date of accepting the application. If it cannot make a decision within twenty days, with the approval of the head of this administrative authority, the time limit may be extended by ten days, and the reasons for the extension shall be informed to the applicant. However, if other provisions are made by laws or regulations, those provisions shall apply.
If, in accordance with the provisions of Article 26 of this Law, the administrative license is handled through unified processing, joint processing, or centralized processing, the processing time shall not exceed forty-five days; if it cannot be completed within forty-five days, with the approval of the head of the people's government at the same level, the time limit may be extended by fifteen days, and the reasons for the extension shall be informed to the applicant.

Article 43 For an administrative license that, according to law, shall be reviewed first by the lower-level administrative authority and then submitted to the higher-level administrative authority for decision, the lower-level administrative authority shall complete the review within twenty days from the date it accepts the application for the administrative license. However, if other provisions are made by laws or regulations, those provisions shall apply.

Article 44 After making a decision to grant an administrative license, the administrative authority shall, within ten days from the date of the decision, issue and deliver the administrative license document to the applicant, or affix a label or stamp the inspection, testing, or quarantine seal.

Article 45 If a hearing, bidding, auction, inspection, testing, quarantine, expert evaluation, or expert review is required according to law for making a decision on an administrative license, the time required for such procedures shall not be counted within the time limits prescribed in this Section. The administrative authority shall inform the applicant in writing of the time required.

Article 46 For matters on which a hearing shall be held for implementing an administrative license as provided by laws, regulations, or rules, or for other major administrative license matters involving public interests that the administrative authority considers necessary to hold a hearing, the administrative authority shall make a public announcement and hold a hearing.

Article 47 Where an administrative license directly involves a significant interest between the applicant and another person, the administrative authority, before making a decision on the administrative license, shall inform the applicant and the interested party of their right to request a hearing; if the applicant or the interested party submits a hearing request within five days from the date of being informed of the hearing right, the administrative authority shall organize a hearing within twenty days.
The applicant and the interested party shall not bear the costs of the hearing organized by the administrative authority.

Article 49 Where a licensee requests to alter matters of an administrative license, the licensee shall file an application with the administrative authority that made the decision on granting the said administrative license; where the statutory requirements and standards are satisfied, the administrative authority shall, according to law, undergo the formalities for alteration.

Article 50 Where a licensee needs to renew the validity period of the lawfully obtained administrative license, the licensee shall file an application with the administrative authority that made the decision on granting the said administrative license 30 days before the expiry of the validity period of the administrative license. However, where laws, regulations, or rules provide otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.
The administrative authority shall, on the basis of the licensee's application, make a decision on whether to grant the renewal before the expiry of the validity period of the said administrative license; if it fails to decide upon expiry, it shall be deemed that the renewal has been granted.

Article 51 For the procedures for implementing administrative licenses, where this Section has provisions, such provisions shall apply; where this Section has no provisions, other relevant provisions of this Chapter shall apply.
Article 52 The procedures for the State Council's implementation of administrative licenses shall be governed by the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 53 Where an administrative license is implemented for matters listed in Item (2) of Article 12 of this Law, the administrative authority shall make a decision by means of public bidding, auction, or other fair competition methods. However, where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.
The specific procedures for an administrative authority to make a decision on granting an administrative license through public bidding, auction, or other methods shall be in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.
After determining the winning bidder or buyer through public bidding or auction procedures, the administrative authority shall make a decision to grant the administrative license, and according to law, issue the administrative license certificate to the winning bidder or buyer.
Where the administrative authority violates the provisions of this Article by failing to adopt public bidding or auction methods, or by violating the procedures for public bidding or auction, thereby harming the lawful rights and interests of applicants, the applicant may, according to law, apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate an administrative action.

Article 54 For the implementation of administrative licenses for matters listed in Item (3) of Article 12 of this Law, where specific qualifications are to be granted to citizens and a national examination shall be held according to law, the administrative authority shall make a decision on granting the administrative license on the basis of the examination results and other statutory requirements; where specific qualifications or qualifications are to be granted to legal persons or other organizations, the administrative authority shall make a decision on granting the administrative license on the basis of the results of assessments of the applicant's composition of professionals, technical conditions, business performance, management level, etc. However, where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.
The examination for specific qualifications of citizens shall be organized by the administrative authority or industry association according to law and shall be held publicly. The administrative authority or industry association shall, in advance, announce the registration requirements, registration methods, examination subjects, and examination syllabus. However, it shall not organize compulsory pre-examination training for the qualification examination, nor shall it designate textbooks or other examination-aid materials.

Article 55 For the implementation of administrative licenses for matters listed in Item (4) of Article 12 of this Law, inspection, testing, and quarantine shall be conducted according to law in accordance with technical standards and technical specifications, and the administrative authority shall make a decision on granting the administrative license on the basis of the results of inspection, testing, and quarantine.
The administrative authority, when conducting inspection, testing, or quarantine, shall, within five days from the date of accepting the application, assign not less than two staff members to carry out inspection, testing, or quarantine in accordance with technical standards and technical specifications. Where it may be determined without further technical analysis of the results of the inspection, testing, or quarantine whether the equipment, facilities, products, or articles comply with technical standards and technical specifications, the administrative authority shall make a decision on granting the administrative license on the spot.
Where the administrative authority decides not to grant the administrative license based on the results of inspection, testing, or quarantine, it shall state in writing the technical standards and technical specifications on which the decision of denial is based.

Article 56 For the implementation of administrative licenses for matters listed in Item (5) of Article 12 of this Law, where the applicant submits complete application materials that comply with the statutory form, the administrative authority shall register the matter on the spot. Where the substantive contents of the application materials need to be verified, the administrative authority shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of Article 34 of this Law.

Article 57 For an administrative license that is subject to quantity limitations, where two or more applicants all meet the statutory requirements and standards, the administrative authority shall make a decision to grant the administrative license according to the order in which the applications for the administrative license are accepted. However, where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.

Article 58 An administrative organ shall not charge any fees for implementing an administrative license or for supervising and inspecting the matters subject to administrative license. However, where laws or administrative regulations provide otherwise, such provisions shall prevail.
An administrative organ shall not charge fees for providing the standard form of application for an administrative license.
The expenses necessary for an administrative organ to implement administrative licenses shall be included in the budget of the administrative organ, guaranteed by the finance at the same level, and appropriated according to the approved budget.

Article 59 Where an administrative organ, when implementing an administrative license, collects fees in accordance with laws or administrative regulations, it shall charge fees according to the statutory items and standards published; all fees collected shall be turned over to the state treasury in full, and no organ or individual may withhold, misappropriate, privately divide, or covertly divide them in any form. The finance department shall not, in any form, return or covertly return to the administrative organ the fees collected for implementing administrative licenses.

Article 60 The higher-level administrative organ shall strengthen supervision and inspection over the implementation of administrative licenses by lower-level administrative organs, and shall promptly correct illegal acts in the implementation of administrative licenses.

Article 61 An administrative organ shall establish and improve a supervision system, and fulfill its supervision responsibilities by verifying the relevant materials reflecting the activities of the licensee in engaging in the matters subject to administrative license.
When supervising and inspecting the activities of a licensee in engaging in the matters subject to administrative license according to law, the administrative organ shall record the circumstances and results of the supervision and inspection, and have the records signed by the supervision and inspection personnel before filing. The public shall have the right to consult the supervision and inspection records of the administrative organ.
The administrative organ shall create conditions to achieve interconnection of computer file systems with the licensee and other relevant administrative organs, to verify the activities of the licensee in engaging in the matters subject to administrative license.

Article 62 An administrative organ may, according to law, conduct sample inspections, tests, and examinations of the products produced and operated by the licensee, and conduct on-site inspections of the licensee's production and operation premises. During the inspection, the administrative organ may, according to law, consult or require the licensee to submit relevant materials; the licensee shall truthfully provide the relevant information and materials.
The administrative organ shall, in accordance with the provisions of laws and administrative regulations, conduct periodic inspections of important equipment and facilities that directly concern public safety, human health, and the safety of life and property. For those that pass the inspection, the administrative organ shall issue corresponding certification documents.

Article 63 When conducting supervision and inspection, an administrative organ shall not hinder the normal production and business operations of the licensee, shall not extort or accept property from the licensee, and shall not seek other benefits.

Article 64 Where a licensee illegally engages in activities concerning the matters subject to administrative license outside the jurisdictional area of the administrative organ that made the administrative license decision, the administrative organ at the place where the illegal act occurred shall, according to law, send a copy of the facts of the violation and the results of the handling to the administrative organ that made the administrative license decision.

Article 65 Individuals and organizations that discover illegal activities in engaging in matters subject to administrative license shall have the right to report to the administrative organ, and the administrative organ shall promptly verify and handle the matter.

Article 66 Where a licensee fails to perform the obligation to develop and utilize natural resources according to law or fails to perform the obligation to utilize public resources according to law, the administrative organ shall order the licensee to make corrections within a specified period; if the licensee fails to make corrections within the specified period, the administrative organ shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 67 A licensee who has obtained an administrative license for market access in a specific industry that directly concerns the public interest shall, in accordance with the service standards, tariff standards prescribed by the state, and the conditions prescribed by the administrative organ according to law, provide users with safe, convenient, stable, and reasonably priced services, and perform the obligation of universal service; without the approval of the administrative organ that made the administrative license decision, the licensee shall not suspend business or close down without authorization.
If the licensee fails to perform the obligations specified in the preceding paragraph, the administrative organ shall order the licensee to make corrections within a specified period, or take effective measures according to law to urge the licensee to perform its obligations.

Article 68 With respect to important equipment and facilities that directly concern public safety, human health, and the safety of life and property, the administrative organ shall supervise the design, construction, installation, and use units in establishing corresponding self-inspection systems.
When, during supervision and inspection, an administrative organ discovers that important equipment and facilities that directly concern public safety, human health, and the safety of life and property have safety hazards, it shall order the cessation of construction, installation, and use, and order the design, construction, installation, and use units to make immediate corrections.

Article 71 Where an administrative license is established in violation of the provisions of Article 17 of this Law, the relevant organ shall order the organ that established such administrative license to make corrections, or shall revoke it according to law.

Article 73 Where a staff member of an administrative organ, in handling an administrative license or conducting supervision and inspection, extorts or accepts property from others or seeks other benefits, if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, administrative sanctions shall be given according to law.

Article 75 Where an administrative organ, in implementing an administrative license, charges fees without authorization or fails to charge fees in accordance with the statutory items and standards, the administrative organ at the higher level or the supervisory organ shall order it to refund the illegally collected fees; and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given administrative sanctions according to law.
Where fees collected according to law for implementing an administrative license are withheld, misappropriated, privately shared, or shared in disguised form, such fees shall be recovered; the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given administrative sanctions according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 76 Where an administrative organ illegally implements an administrative license, causing damage to the lawful rights and interests of a party, it shall pay compensation in accordance with the provisions of the State Compensation Law.

Article 77 Where an administrative organ fails to perform its supervision duties according to law or performs supervision inadequately, causing serious consequences, the administrative organ at the higher level or the supervisory organ shall order it to make corrections, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be given administrative sanctions according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 78 Where an applicant for an administrative license conceals relevant information or provides false materials in applying for the administrative license, the administrative organ shall not accept the application or shall not grant the administrative license, and shall give a warning; if the application for the administrative license concerns matters directly related to public security, human health, or safety of life and property, the applicant shall not apply for such administrative license again within one year.

Article 79 Where a licensee obtains an administrative license by deceit, bribery, or other illegitimate means, the administrative organ shall impose an administrative penalty according to law; if the administrative license obtained concerns matters directly related to public security, human health, or safety of life and property, the applicant shall not apply for such administrative license again within three years; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 81 Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization, without obtaining an administrative license, engages in an activity for which an administrative license shall be obtained according to law, the administrative organ shall take measures to stop such activity according to law and impose an administrative penalty according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Article 82 The time limits for an administrative organ to implement an administrative license as provided for in this Law shall be calculated in working days, excluding statutory holidays.

Article 83 This Law shall come into force as of July 1, 2004.
The provisions on administrative licenses made before the date when this Law comes into force shall be sorted out by the formulating organs in accordance with the provisions of this Law; those that are not in conformity with the provisions of this Law shall cease to be implemented as of the date when this Law comes into force.
